lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Enclave 7, 2312. Fourth floor, twenty-three forty. Everyone else signed out at six because the Steward allocates rest and the Steward is not cruel.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Eleven years I have closed this quarter in an afternoon. Tonight it will not close, and it will not close by about the same amount it did not close last quarter.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The monitor array is on the desk. The window looks out over the housing blocks. The corridor door is shut, which is how doors are here.
